entities.summary: Justin Falk is a Canadian former professional ice hockey defenceman. He last played with the Belleville Senators in the American Hockey League (AHL). He made his National Hockey League debut in the 2009–10 season with the Minnesota Wild, and has since played for the New York Rangers, Columbus Blue Jackets, Buffalo Sabres, and Ottawa Senators. Justin is the current General Manager and Head Coach for the Winkler Flyers in the Manitoba Junior Hockey League.
